title: Eggless team morning tea cake for Rouse Hill and Stanhope Gardens offices
summary:
Need an office birthday cake near Rouse Hill or Stanhope Gardens where nobody has to ask about eggs? Riverstone does it in one order.

Every cake is 100% eggless, so the vegetarian, the Jain colleague and the person with an egg allergy all get a slice. A 10-inch serves 20-22 and starts at $74.99. A 12-inch serves 25-30 from $89.99. Fifteen flavours, any message piped on top.

Order 48 hours ahead. Collect from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, from 6am on weekdays, free parking at the door. That is the cake sitting in the office fridge before the 9am meeting.

Send your size, flavour and message on WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
